gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu reads modern and tidy, with a towering x-height and curve ends held back from the stroke. Amatic SC sketches the headings in a thin, quirky hand.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Amatic SC draws its headings like casual pen lines, rustic and a bit quirky, with endings that stop short of the stem. And Noto Sans Ogham answers with tall, bold-looking lowercase and wide gaps in the e.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Amatic SC writes its headings in a single squeezed line, quirky and rustic, with stroke ends as wide as the middle. Noto Sans Ol Chiki packs words into solid blocks.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle give Amatic SC its rustic, hand-lettered look, with terminals that stop well away from the stem. Noto Sans Old Hungarian is the sturdy, open counterweight.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Contemporary and businesslike, Noto Sans Old Italic sits tightly between x-height and cap height, while Amatic SC scribbles headings with no thick-to-thin shift at all. The two make an odd, appealing pair.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Noto Sans Old North Arabian reads dense and approachable, with a tall lowercase band and terminals flaring outward like tongs. Amatic SC, drawn in one weight throughout, sketches headings above it, and paragraphs stay compact.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: A plain, unshaded line that never swells makes Amatic SC feel hand-squeezed and rustic, with quirky terminals held off the stem. Noto Sans Old Permic then settles into paragraphs with rounded, open forms and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Noto Sans Old Persian reads lofty and clean, its open counters breathing into the white space around a tall lowercase. Amatic SC handles the headings, and paragraphs of the body keep a light, spacious feel.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Noto Sans Old Sogdian stands tall, its x-height nearly touching cap height and its wide mouths staying crisp when shrunk. And Amatic SC adds a hand-drawn, rustic charm with no hairlines to squint at.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic reads chunky and friendly, with tall lowercase and open-mouthed curves that stay clear. Amatic SC is the quirky one, a rustic hand whose lowercase a has no hairlines, while the body does the steady work.
